_comment: Schema reference for backend-only jobs/{jobId}/dispatch_runs/{generationId}. The deterministic generationId names one finite search generation.
_spec_ref: docs/phase4_decisions.md P4-D006, P4-D007, P4-D008, P4-D013, P4-D026, P4-D033, P4-D034 and §jobs/{jobId}/dispatch_runs/{generationId}
_invariants: Candidate driverId values, attemptedDriverIds, and excludedDriverIds are unique within a generation; candidates, attemptedDriverIds, and excludedDriverIds each contain at most 30 entries; authoritative nextCandidateIndex never decreases and never exceeds candidates.length. assigned is nonterminal. Accepted-driver cancellation preserves nextCandidateIndex exactly and preserves attempted/excluded evidence. Dispatch worker ownership exists only on jobs.dispatchLeaseOwner and jobs.dispatchLeaseUntil; this schema has no owner or lease fields. Exhausted is legal only after every persisted candidate has a terminal non-accepted outcome and no eligible untried candidate remains under policySnapshot. Provider/config failure is not exhaustion.

_state_machine.finalizationRule: finalizedAt is null for active and assigned. It is set exactly once when entering exhausted, cancelled_customer, completed, or superseded and never cleared.
_state_machine.supersededNote: assigned->superseded is not a legal Stage 1 transition. No complete authoritative operation exists for safely superseding an active accepted assignment while preserving all job, offer, driver, financial, and run domain state. Only active->superseded is permitted for explicitly invalidating a generation that has not yet produced an accepted driver.

_accepted_driver_cancellation.candidateDriver: remains in attemptedDriverIds and is added to excludedDriverIds if not already present
_accepted_driver_cancellation.nextCandidateIndex: preserved exactly; must not advance, decrease, or restart
_accepted_driver_cancellation.workerLeaseOwnership: job-only dispatchLeaseOwner and dispatchLeaseUntil; no dispatch-run owner/lease fields

_ola_authorization: policySnapshot contains immutable search/ranking evidence only and never contains olaMonthlyPairCap. Before every future Matrix pair reservation and provider attempt, runtime must revalidate the current dispatch_config/main cap and circuit-breaker state. A recovered run cannot authorize against an older observed cap.

status.description: assigned is explicitly nonterminal and may return to active after accepted-driver cancellation. Terminal status plus finalizedAt records why continuation became permanently unnecessary or impossible.

policyVersion.description: Version of immutable search/ranking policy only; never provider-spend authorization.

policySnapshot.description: Immutable search/config snapshot used to prove the bounded search that actually ran. It contains neither provider authorization/cost caps nor credentials/raw provider responses.

reasonCode.description: Safe operational code only; no provider body, secret, or personal data.

finalizedAt.description: Null for active/assigned. Set exactly once only for exhausted, cancelled_customer, completed, or superseded.
